meta.title: Which Subject Is Best?
meta.textType: functional: two emails on one topic, from a pen pal and a reply

paragraphs: On Tuesday, February twenty-third, Lily sat at her desk at home after school. Pip slept on the floor under her chair. Her notebook lay beside the laptop, with a small drawing of a flask in the corner. There was a new email from her pen pal Grace. Grace wrote it on Sunday. The subject line said "My favorite subject." Lily opened the email and read it slowly.

Dear Lily, thank you for your last email. I received it on Friday, and I read it twice. Ms. Ong asked us to write about our favorite subject. She tells us that a good email gives a reason. My favorite subject is PE, because I love swimming. Our team has training three times a week. We have a competition in March, and I hope to win. I also hope to dive in the Olympic Games one day. I think swimming could be my career. My friends say that I swim like a fish. I love the water, and I feel strong when I swim. After training, I buy a bottle of water at our school shop for eighty cents. Our school does not use social media, so we write emails. What is your favorite subject? How is Pip? Best wishes, Grace.

Dear Grace, thank you for your email. It is great to hear about your swimming. My favorite subject is science, because we do experiments. Our weekly science lesson is on Wednesday, so Wednesday is my best day. In February, we learned where rain comes from. Teacher Kim says that the same water goes around again and again. Which subject is the hardest for you? Please tell me about your competition in March. On Saturday, the Explorers visit the town library, and I will write to you about it. Pip is asleep under my chair, and he sends a quiet snore. Best wishes, Lily.

Lily read her answer twice before she clicked SEND. She checked every line, because Teacher Kim likes emails with no mistakes. Then the email went to Grace, far away. Lily looked at the screen and smiled.

Pip woke up and put his head on her foot. "Grace swims very well, Pip," said Lily. "She has training three times a week." Pip moved his tail and looked at the door. Lily laughed and took his red ball from the shelf.
text.summary: Lily reads an email from her pen pal Grace about her favorite subject, PE, and writes a reply about science. Each girl gives a reason, and Lily asks which subject is the hardest.
